bio: Garriane is the contraction of Garry and Ariane, and originality is the name of the game here! In the kitchens, Garry, an Australian, concocts seasonal, ingredient-focused cuisine that taps into influences from around the world. The restaurant is now open for lunch as well as Monday for dinner, with a menu of vegetarian and vegan options, and operates as a café in the mornings and afternoons....
